supplier_enterprise: mandatory requirements and deadlines with document/section citations
buyer_side: document contradictions and unclear evaluation review
offerings.bid_partner: Software plus human bid support, quoted fixed monthly amount; customer count unverified

pricing.pricing_basis: individual company quote based on bid volume, users, onboarding and contract; official pricing page explicitly says no public price list

market_implication: Generic source-linked supplier preflight, requirement checks, bid/no-bid and market intelligence are already marketed by an end-to-end competitor. limits: Vendor advertising is not independently verified functionality or delivery quality.
